source: Present narrow ground banks northwest, west and south of the main bailey, adjoining its already accepted estimated ground boundary and the southeastern terrace. Village text describes surrounding belt enclosures continuing northwest and south, but does not supply measured edges or a current flat floor. This bounded C-shaped ground strip retains the original uneven numerical surface and grade breaks instead of manufacturing a flat belt or moat. Its perimeter is explicitly estimated; separate southeastern terrace accounts for the eastern continuation. No exact medieval bank width, construction date or original grade is claimed.
